rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's current energy must be strictly greater than the shot power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, it must have a target that was scanned this turn (age 0) and its gun must point at that target within 3.0 degrees; if it has no target, it never fires.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

deleted_starters.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold, but the battles logged S3 violations
explanation.summary: Verus proved both rules it checked, S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford) and S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn with the gun aimed at it). No rule was rejected. The battles did log a rule called S3, first on turn 2 in both arenas (41 turns in the open arena, 76 in the city map), but S3 is not among the rules or verdicts I was given, so I can't say what it covers or whether the code can break it.
